text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the February Stakes. Perhaps 
because it is the first race toward her 
goal of taking 1st place, a restless buzz 
fills the venue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokyo Racecourse is also the venue where 
one of Japan's most prestigious races, the 
Japanese Derby, is held.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She knows she can't match the Derby's 
popularity right now. Still, Smart Falcon 
enters the race determined to win and keep 
the momentum going for what's to come.
